args.question: Summarize the actual outputs for the three input compounds, identify the prediction model used and its limitations. Do not infer clinical safety.

analysis.prediction_model: ADMET-AI (MPNN, Chemprop-RDKit; Swanson et al. 2023) combined with empirical heuristics (Lombardo 2002 for Vd, Lobell & Sivarajah 2003 for fu_plasma, BCS/logP for CLr)
analysis.limitations: These values are computational predictions for hypothesis generation only. Models contain inherent error margins (e.g., RMSE ~0.15 log units for fu_plasma; ~0.48 log-units for vd_lkg) and heuristics like cl_renal_fraction are directional only. All values require experimental confirmation before use in regulatory PBPK submissions.
